description: Looking for members interested to participate in this challenge
summary: Our project is an animation video showing the life log of the Apollo mission and it's lander. This video is in the perspective of the Apollo lander itself. The lander is expressing it's life mission and the emotions along its journey  and is left behind in moon. The project is best suited for high school students such that they can learn more about the mission and the technical aspects in a more simple and friendly manner.
details: This project which is animated in the perspective of the Apollo mission equipment itself provides a touching journey for the high school students to learn about the technical aspects as well as the inner feelings of it. Since it is left behind on moon, we try to bring it back to life by reminiscing its legacy. The students who have always looked at the Mission in awe can feel the inner emotions and learn more about it through this. We used the help of Canva and AI tools to help generate the animations. We have kept in mind that our audience is children and made all technical areas simple such that everyone can understand this clearly.
